snippet.title: Star Trek Online: Rediscovered Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Star Trek Online's next season, Rediscovered, is available now on PC!

Rediscovered brings Spock through the ages to Star Trek Online, starring Ethan Peck as Lieutenant Spock (Star Trek: Strange New Worlds) Piotr Michael as Captain Spock (Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country), and Lisa LoCicero (Star Trek: The Next Generation) as Lieutenant Miral Paris.

This update continues the remaster of Star Trek Online’s fan-favorite “The Ultimate Klingon” storyline, the story that began with Undiscovered’s reimagining. Across the galaxy, time is beginning to fracture. The disappearances of key members of the Federation and the Klingon Empire have triggered a cascade of temporal disturbances. 

Captains must return to the year 2409 and unravel the mystery behind the disappearances of Lieutenant Miral Paris and Ambassador B'vat. Her final message on the Gateway Planet will send players on a temporal chase across Star Trek history, where Captains meet Spock through the ages and continue the quest to stop B'vat!

Explore the Final Frontier: https://playstartrekonline.com/
